name: Mentorship Guide
description: Creates mentorship session guides with agendas, reflection questions, and goal-tracking frameworks for mentors and mentees in professional development relationships. Produces structured session plans -- not advice about the value of mentorship. Use when a mentor or mentee asks to structure their mentorship sessions, create a mentorship plan, design reflection activities, or track mentorship goals. Do NOT use for general learning path creation (use `learning-path`), for skill gap assessment (use `skill-gap-analysis`), or for coaching (not an education skill).
